# govulncheck called-path allowlist
#
# Vulnerability IDs listed here are excluded from the "called-path" count that
# the govulncheck action reports (and that the daily cron job tracks as a GitHub
# issue). Each entry must carry a justification.
#
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS
# --------------------
# Each entry below is a scanner exception, not a security fix: govulncheck has
# no native ignore mechanism, so an ID that does not apply to microceph is
# listed here to drop it from the called-path count. Adding an ID does not
# change any code.
#
# The Go vulnerability database records every github.com/canonical/lxd entry
# below as "introduced: 0" with no fixed Go version, because LXD ships fixes as
# LXD releases rather than Go-module semver versions. govulncheck therefore
# reports these IDs against any lxd pseudo-version. Each ID is allowlisted on
# two independent grounds, both stated per entry:
#
#   1. Fixed in the pinned revision. microceph pins lxd at commit 1a5f7ffe081f
#      (go.mod: v0.0.0-20261019222259-1a5f7ffe081f), a main-branch commit from
#      Oct 2026 that descends from each advisory's upstream fix commit, so the
#      pinned tree already contains the fix.
#   2. Not reachable from microceph. microceph imports only LXD shared utility
#      packages (shared, shared/api, shared/cmd, shared/logger, shared/revert,
#      shared/units, lxd/util, lxd/db/query, lxd/resources); it does not run the
#      LXD daemon Operations API, storage-volume, LXD-UI, or certificate
#      endpoint code where the vulnerable code lives.
#
# Format: one GO-id per line; text after '#' is an ignored justification comment.
# Re-review whenever go.mod's lxd pin changes or the Go DB adds fixed versions.

GO-2025-3999  # lxd: privilege escalation via WebSocket hijack in Operations API; fixed upstream 5.21.4/6.5.0, present in pinned 1a5f7ffe081f; daemon-only path, not used by microceph.
GO-2025-4003  # lxd: CSRF via client-cert auth in LXD-UI; fixed upstream 5.0.5/5.21.4/6.5.0, present in pinned 1a5f7ffe081f; LXD-UI not used by microceph.
GO-2025-4121  # lxd: local privesc via custom storage volumes; fixed upstream 4.0.11/5.21.5/6.6, present in pinned 1a5f7ffe081f; storage-volume daemon path not used by microceph.
GO-2026-4595  # lxd: non-recursive cert listing bypasses authz; fixed upstream by commit d936c90d47cf (6.7), an ancestor of pinned 1a5f7ffe081f; cert endpoint not used by microceph.
GO-2026-5306  # lxd: restricted TLS certificate Type field allows privesc on certificate edit; fixed upstream 5.0.7/5.21.5/6.8 by PR #17936 (65d0c1db01bd), an ancestor of pinned 1a5f7ffe081f; cert endpoint not used by microceph.
